<timestamp>Monday, Aug 3, 2026, 11:03 AM (UTC+2)</timestamp>

the story timestamp cached is display on the preview and the editor but not on the shared page
I'll look at how story timestamps are rendered on the preview, editor, and shared page to find why the shared view is missing the cached value.
The shared page isn't passing `cachedAt` into the live header controls. Checking whether the share API returns that field.
The API already returns `cachedAt`; the shared page just never passes it to `StoryPageHeader`. Wiring that through for both owner and viewer headers.
The immediate invalidate on refresh won't wait for the mutation to finish — I'll fix that in the live-settings hook instead.
`tsc` is clean. Simplifying: the `shareId` invalidation isn't needed for the display bug, so I'll drop that and only pass `cachedAt`.
Owner refresh on the shared page also won't update without invalidating `storyShare.get`. Restoring that invalidation.

The shared page already received `cachedAt` from `storyShare.get`, but never passed it into `StoryPageHeader` — unlike preview and editor.

It’s now wired for both owner and viewer headers, so the live “updated … ago” timestamp shows on the shared page too.
